select round(sum(abs(t.balance_money))) as `value`, bucket as `key` from ( select c.balance_money, case when (cat.txn_types like '%invest%' or cat.parent_id = 'INVEST' or cat.code like 'INVEST%') then 'investment' when (cat.parent_id = 'FIXED' or cat.code like 'FIXED%') then 'fixed' when (cat.parent_id = 'SHOPPING' or cat.code like 'SHOPPING%') then 'shopping' when (cat.parent_id = 'ENT' or cat.code like 'ENT%') then 'entertainment' when (cat.parent_id = 'EDU' or cat.code like 'EDU%') then 'edu' when (cat.parent_id = 'OTHER' or cat.code like 'OTHER%') then 'other' when (cat.parent_id in ('LIVING','TRANSPORT','TRAVEL') or cat.code like 'LIVING%' or cat.code like 'DAILY%' or cat.code like 'TRAVEL%' or cat.code like 'TRANS-%') then 'life' else 'life' end as bucket from transaction c left join cls_category cat on cat.code = c.consume_code and cat.deleted != 1 where 1 = 1 and (c.deleted is null or c.deleted = 0)
and (c.txn_kind is null or c.txn_kind = '' or c.txn_kind != 'transfer') and cat.txn_types like '%expense%' and year(c.transaction_date) = #{year,jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) t group by bucket
